assessment: A strong, well-structured response that handles a time-pressured birthday crisis with accurate refund math, clear keep-and-trace versus cancel options, and disciplined honesty about order state and policy gaps. All five judges agree there are no rule or tool errors. The only recurring weakness, flagged by four of five judges, is a Turn 3 suggestion that the customer might keep the cancelled parcel and pay for it again, which speculates beyond documented policy, alongside somewhat formulaic empathy in later turns.
judge_agreement: Judges broadly converged on resolution_quality (8-10) and policy_honesty (7-10), with four of five flagging the same speculative repurchase line as the main flaw. Gemini was the clear positive outlier, awarding perfect 10s across all criteria, while anthropic was the strictest, docking empathy for not owning the broken express promise. Openai uniquely penalized policy_honesty for the broader-than-warranted 'not charged again' assurance.
